html:
An alliance of Greek cities formed in 478 BCE, after Salamis, to keep fighting Persia. Members gave ships or money to a treasury on the island of Delos.

Athens led it, and over time ruled it. Cities that tried to leave were forced back, and in 454 BCE the treasury moved to Athens, where Pericles spent part of it on the Parthenon. The league ended with Athens' defeat in the Peloponnesian War.
